utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, have you got the tools ready for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven't checked my toolbox yet—been so busy with errands. Did someone send out a list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No list that I know of, but I figured we'd just need the usual wrenches and screwdrivers. Should I bring mine just in case?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard you're starting that repair drive. I've got some spare wrenches and a toolbox if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus. I think I might have a toolbox somewhere, but sure, bring 'em over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, I'll swing by your place after lunch with my wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think they're collecting old electronics down at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I heard something about it, but I'm worried about parking — that lot gets jammed on weekends.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, don't you worry about that — they're setting up a temporary overflow lot behind the old bakery. I heard it from my cousin who's helping organize it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Opal, are you working on a repair drive for something? Need a hand with it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, just tinkering with an old GPS unit. Could use a second pair of eyes on the wiring, if you're offering.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I've got a steady hand for wiring. Show me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, did you hear about the repair drive they're organizing? I already told half the street about it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, yeah... I heard something about that. Still figuring out what I can actually spare.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, don't overthink it! Even an old lamp or a broken toaster would be perfect — they're taking everything!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I've been looking over the sign-up sheet for the repair drive, and I think we're off to a great start, Leo. Would you be able to lend a hand with the tool inventory?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can do that. When do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: How about this Saturday morning? I'll have the tools laid out by then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure I have enough information to form an opinion yet. Could you tell me more about what you've seen or heard?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Well, I noticed the repair drive folks setting up near the old oak tree early this morning. They seemed pretty organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Near the old oak tree, you say? Did you notice any equipment or how many people were there?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mara, do we have a list of items needed for the repair drive? I can help coordinate with other parents.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think we have one started, but let me check my notes. I can share what I have with you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, Mara. I've got a few parents who are eager to contribute once they know what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard from someone down the block that the repair drive is happening this weekend—do you know if that's right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, yes, I think it's Saturday morning—I saw a flyer pinned up at the café.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Saturday morning, got it. Do you know where we're supposed to meet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that. Works better if you tighten the screws, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that? I've heard different things.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, maybe I got that wrong. I just skimmed it somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard you're helping with the repair drive. That's nice of you to get involved.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, am I? I mean, yes—I think I remember signing up for something. What day is it again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's Saturday. Did you forget? That's okay, happens to me all the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that's right! We could really use some extra tools if you have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'll spread the word, and I think I have a hammer and some screwdrivers I can bring along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I haven't heard much about it. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure either, I've only heard bits and pieces. What have you heard?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Honestly, I haven't caught any solid details myself—just whispers here and there when I'm out grabbing groceries.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm sorry, I think I forgot what that was about. Could you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive is this weekend where neighbors come together to fix up old stuff — bikes, furniture, electronics. It's at the community center on Saturday from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right! I remember now — I think I have an old toaster that's been sitting in my garage for years. Should I bring that along?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, that thing. I think I saw something about it, but I've been so swamped lately, I might've missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's this Saturday at 10, at the community center. Bring tools if you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday, huh? I'll try to remember. Tools, got it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it’s a neighborhood effort to fix up old tools and appliances, I think they’re setting it up for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Saturday morning, huh? I've got a few spare wrenches and screwdrivers I could bring along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Quinn, I'm glad I caught you—I was just thinking about the repair drive and wanted to see how you're coming along with gathering those spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I've been buzzing around like a little bee! Got some old fans from the Johnsons, and the Hernandez family offered a bunch of screws and hinges.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful news! Every bit helps—between the fans and those screws, we'll be able to fix up quite a few things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the repair drive sounds like a great idea! I've got some old tools I could contribute.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Jules! We're really in need of screwdrivers and wrenches. Do you have any of those?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I've got a whole set of both—let me dig them out of the garage for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo! I'm organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood this Saturday. Would you be able to help out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can help! I have a list of what supplies we have. Do you need me to gather anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Cleo! Could you check if we have extra duct tape and zip ties? We always run out of those.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina, I've been hearing bits and pieces about a repair drive happening around here. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a community effort to fix up houses for folks who can't afford repairs — are you looking to help out or need some work done?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'd love to help out—I've got some free time and I'm handy with a paintbrush. Where do I sign up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive, yeah. I think I saw something about that—is it still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not sure, actually; I haven't seen any updates about it. Did you hear it's still on?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, I thought I saw a flyer, but honestly I skimmed it—could be next weekend too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, the repair drive—how can I help out with that?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure there's a repair drive? I haven't heard anything about it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I saw a flyer about it at the community center—let me grab it to show you!
